content.comment_body: Hi! I am working with [product_name] hardware and [product_name] software [version_no], using [product_name] [version_no], and exporting data to Microsoft Office Excel 2007. I have successfully connected 5 discrete inputs. Now, I need to connect 5 UP/DOWN counters. I set up a counter in Excel and tested it by activating it through the input I6—this part works, but the counter function itself does not respond. Am I missing something? Thank you!
I'm not sure what the issue is. For my setup, everything works as expected...

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing difficulties integrating a DWord counter from [product_name] hardware into Excel using [product_name] software and export tools. While discrete inputs operate correctly, the counter function does not respond as intended when triggered through Excel and physical input. The troubleshooting process is ongoing, with peers uncertain about the exact cause.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates seamless integration of the UP/DOWN counter with the hardware so that counter increments are properly recorded and displayed in Excel using the access tool.
